{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Remove rows with sentinel value -999 in baseline
trial_clean = trial_df[trial_df['biomarker_baseline'] != -999]

# Compute the change in biomarker (final - baseline)
trial_clean['biomarker_change'] = trial_clean['biomarker_final'] - trial_clean['biomarker_baseline']

# Compute average change by arm
avg_change_by_arm = trial_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Compute response rate by arm
response_rate_by_arm = trial_clean.groupby('arm')['responded'].mean()

# Compute baseline biomarker by arm
baseline_by_arm = trial_clean.groupby('arm')['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Check the key confounding: treatment arm has higher baseline and more severe cases
# This means we cannot directly compare raw differences

# Compute the biomarker change stratified by severity
stratified_change = trial_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Compute response rate stratified by severity
stratified_response = trial_clean.groupby(['arm', 'severity'])['responded'].mean()

# Compute average biomarker change within each severity level, averaged across arms
avg_change_by_severity = trial_clean.groupby('severity')['biomarker_change'].mean()

# Compute average response rate within each severity level, averaged across arms
avg_response_by_severity = trial_clean.groupby('severity')['responded'].mean()

# Compute the difference in biomarker change between arms within each severity stratum
change_diff_by_severity = stratified_change.unstack('arm')['treatment'] - stratified_change.unstack('arm')['control']

# Compute the difference in response rate between arms within each severity stratum
response_diff_by_severity = stratified_response.unstack('arm')['treatment'] - stratified_response.unstack('arm')['control']

# Print results
print("\nAverage biomarker change by arm:")
print(avg_change_by_arm)

print("\nDifference in biomarker change by severity:")
print(change_diff_by_severity)

print("\nDifference in response rate by severity:")
print(response_diff_by_severity)"}
